data.body: Second instance in the same close: after the [non-codebase] tag, the close was refused again because a tagged item also needs an indented 'provenance: environment=...; principal=...; privilege_posture=...; instrument=... — ...' continuation line. The verifier's remediation text never mentions this requirement, and adding the line is a further plan-text edit that stales the plan-review attestation again. So one external criterion cost three refused closes and two fresh plan reviews. AC addition: the verifier's remediation names the provenance line, and the provenance line is normalized out of plan material like the tag.
